from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyAccountsPayable(BaseModel):
    """Accounts payable data extracted from one company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Full company name as reported")
    security_code: str | None = Field(description="Securities trading code, e.g., 002812")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="Report period, e.g., '2024年第一季度'")
    accounts_payable_期末: float | None = Field(description="Accounts payable balance at period end (current)")
    accounts_payable_期初: float | None = Field(description="Accounts payable balance at period start/beginning")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit, e.g., '元'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    accounts_payable_records: list[CompanyAccountsPayable]
